contamination: NOT a clean test. rule: At each month's last close, rank SPY QQQ IWM EFA EEM GLD IEF TLT by 6-month total return (dividend-adjusted); the top 4 each get 25% if their 6-month return beats T-bills over the same 6 months, otherwise that slot is in T-bills. Held all month. 10 bps per side.
benchmark: Equal-weight hold of the same 8 ETFs, total returns, daily fixed weights

pass_rule.statistic: Newey-West (21 lags) t of daily alpha over the benchmark, excess of T-bills
